divergences.description: T010 says the keypad tap-target token should be 72 dp and that no other new token is needed. The diff sets sizeKeypadTapTarget to 56 and also adds three tokens the plan didn't list: sizeProgressDot, sizeBiometricIconContainer and sizeBiometricIcon.

T001 and T002 are marked done, but the diff has no change to pubspec.yaml (adding local_auth and crypto) or to ios/Runner/Info.plist (adding NSFaceIDUsageDescription). The new code imports both packages, so it won't build or run without those changes.

The plan allows a one-line change in login_signup_page.dart (redirect to vault instead of home), and the spec says F000's login screen is reused unmodified. The diff instead redesigns the screen (card container, labels moved out of the fields, hint texts, a different title style, a new mode-toggle text) and adds a new 'usar biometria' link that pushes the vault route.

The plan allows a one-line change in splash_page.dart (the authenticated branch pushes vault). The diff also changes the splash layout from a centered Column to a Stack, with the loading dots and retry prompt moved to the bottom.

The diff adds a UsePinRequested event, a bloc handler for it, and a 'Usar PIN' link on the biometric screen that jumps straight to PIN entry. None of these are in the planned event list (T020) or the planned UI (T028).
